title: Qwen3.5-9B quality-evaluation corpus case and category file
description: Authoring contract for model/quality-eval/cases/<category>.json. The root schema validates one category file; #/$defs/case validates a single case. Category-to-metric binding follows model/quality-eval/quality-fixture-spec.json. Semantic rules that JSON Schema cannot express (deterministic split derivation, production tool-name membership, forbidden content patterns, per-category minimums) are enforced by scripts/model-artifact/validate_quality_corpus.py.

settings.description: Deterministic generation settings. 'profile' is the governance generation profile (governance/MODEL_DECISION.md); 'mode' is the literal host/engine wire value (contracts/host-api/contract.json, contracts/engine-api/contract.json); 'enable_thinking' is the derived native flag (mode == 'deep'). max_output_tokens is bounded by the engine's accepted 1..256 range.
